about.label: About the app
about.title: About
about.description: Track your income and expenses — works offline.
about.longDescription: A simple income and expense tracker. Add entries by hand or by voice in English, Bengali or Hindi, set monthly budgets and see reports. Your data stays on your device.

local.title: Your data stays on this device
local.body: Transactions, categories, budgets and preferences are stored only in this app's local database on your device. The app does not encrypt this database itself: it relies on your device's screen lock and storage protection, and it is excluded from Android's automatic cloud backup.

account.title: No account needed
account.body: The app does not ask you to sign in or create an account.

cloud.title: No cloud sync
cloud.body: The app has no server for your data. It does not sync or upload your data, and none of it is sent to the developer.

voice.title: Voice entry uses your device's speech service
voice.body: When you use voice entry, your speech is processed by the speech recognition service of your device or operating system (for example Google on Android or Apple on iOS), not by this app. That service may work offline or may send audio over the internet, depending on your device and language, and its provider's privacy policy applies. The app saves only the recognized text, and only after you review and save the entry.

receipts.title: Receipt photos stay on this device
receipts.body: When you scan a receipt, the camera photo is read by on-device text recognition — it is not uploaded. The photo and the receipt details are stored in the app only after you save the expense. Receipts are not included in backups; restoring a backup or clearing all data deletes them.

updates.title: Update check
updates.body: When the app starts, it downloads a small public file from the developer's website to see whether a newer version is available or required. No personal data is sent; like any website, the server can see your device's internet address. The app works normally when you are offline.

ads.title: Ads by Google
ads.body: The Dashboard and Reports screens show a banner ad from Google AdMob. To show ads, Google’s advertising SDK collects and shares your device’s IP address (which can indicate your approximate location), your Android advertising ID and app set ID, ad interactions such as taps, and app performance information, for advertising, analytics and fraud prevention. In regions where it is required, the app asks for your consent first, and you can change it under Settings → Ad privacy options. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in Android settings. Your transactions, amounts, notes, receipts and voice entries are never shared with Google or any ad network. Ads never appear on the entry, voice, receipt or review screens.

backups.title: You control backup files
backups.body: Backup and CSV files are created only when you ask. They are not encrypted and go only where you choose to save or share them.

deletion.title: Deleting your data
deletion.body: “Clear all data” deletes all transactions and budgets from the app. Uninstalling the app removes its local data from the device, unless your device's own system backup kept a copy. Backup or exported files you saved elsewhere are not affected — delete them separately.

help.intro: Have a question, found a problem or want to suggest a feature? Contact us or check the common questions below.

add.q: How do I add income or an expense?
add.a: Tap the + button in the tab bar. Choose Expense or Income, enter the amount, pick a category and date, then save.

voice.a: Open the Voice tab, tap the microphone and say something like “Spent 250 on groceries”. You always see a review screen before anything is saved. Change the voice language in Settings → Voice.

edit.q: How do I edit or delete a transaction?
edit.a: Tap a transaction in the list to open it. Change the details and save, or use Delete to remove it.

budgets.q: How do I set a monthly budget?
budgets.a: Open the Reports tab and tap the budget card. You can set an overall limit and limits for categories for each month.

export.q: How do I export my transactions?
export.a: Go to More → Settings → Export transactions. Choose a period and CSV or PDF, then save or share the file.

backup.q: How do I keep my data safe or move it to a new phone?
backup.a: Use Settings → Back up data to create a backup file and keep it somewhere safe. On the new phone, use Settings → Restore data. Restoring replaces all data in the app.

language.q: How do I change the language?
language.a: Go to More → Settings → Language. The app language and the voice language are separate settings.

privacy.a: No. Your data stays on your device and the app works offline. Files are shared only when you choose to export or back up.
